label: The framework files a signed-out visitor may download

params.name: files
params.label: address patterns (* = any characters) under /static and /core-static the public pages need: the sign-in shell, the landing, brand pictures, tours

description_nl: 2026-10-16 (core/private_static.py): only read when chip static.signed_out is on. A file under a static.signed_out root that matches none of these patterns (nor the portal's extra_public) answers 404 to a visitor who is not signed in; a member gets every file. The sign-in shell (index.html, app.js, app.css, shell.js and what it imports), the landing (showcase.*), brand pictures (mail logos are read by mail apps, signed out) and tours stay public. Matching is case-sensitive and default-deny: a new screen file is protected without being listed.
weight_basis: A framework file list, no business content.
